views.name: address_components
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    a."address_id",
    a."line_1" AS "line1",
    a."line_2" AS "line2",
    a."line_1" || ', ' || a."line_2" AS "full_address"
FROM Addresses a
views.description: Extracts address line components from the address record.
validated_on: What is the first and second line for all addresses?

views.name: course_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT c.course_id
FROM Courses c
WHERE 1=1
views.description: Selects all courses from the database.

views.name: find_math_course
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.course_description AS description
FROM Courses AS T1
WHERE
  T1.course_name = 'math course'
views.description: Select the course description for the 'math course' entry.

views.name: port_chelsea_addresses
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    a."address_id" AS address,
    a."line_1" AS line1,
    a."line_2" AS line2,
    a."line_3" AS line3,
    a."city" AS city,
    a."zip_postcode" AS zip_postcode,
    a."state_province_county" AS state_province_county,
    a."country" AS country,
    a."other_address_details" AS other_address_details
FROM
    Addresses a
WHERE
    a."city" = 'Port Chelsea'
views.description: Select addresses located in Port Chelsea.

views.name: city_zip_lookup
views.body_sql: SELECT 'zip_code' AS zip_code, T1.zip_postcode AS zip_code FROM Addresses T1 WHERE T1.city = 'Port Chelsea'
views.description: Selects the zip code associated with a given city name.

views.name: department_id_degree_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.department_id,
  COUNT(se.degree_program_id) AS degree_count
FROM Departments AS d
JOIN Degree_Programs AS dp
  ON d.department_id = dp.department_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se
  ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id
GROUP BY
  d.department_id
views.description: Maps department IDs to their degree counts.
